subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should the legacy no-code persisted diagnostic cleanup stay in runtime stale detection for this PR, or be moved to doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: Repository policy treats persisted state and runtime compatibility paths as upgrade-sensitive; the explicit marker follows prior direction, but the legacy fallback intentionally changes upgraded persisted-registry behavior.

options.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
options.body: Accept the bounded runtime rederive for legacy no-code missing-source rows once the contributor provides latest-head real output for the upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Land only the explicit marker/schema portion and move pre-code row cleanup into doctor or migration-owned code before accepting the upgrade path.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainership can waive the extra proof ask and accept the source/test evidence as sufficient for the persisted-state compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded runtime rederive for legacy no-code missing-source rows once the contributor provides latest-head real output for the upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is about SQLite-backed plugin registry state and upgrade behavior, where this history points most strongly to `steipete`.
